notes: «أنه سمع هانئا» names Hani' as the source (rule 5), so he is a link; «مولى عثمان» is kept as a descriptor of the name
«كان عثمان» begins the story about Uthman, who is its subject, not a transmitter
after the saying the text has «وقال رسول الله» (a second quoted saying of the Prophet) and the commentary «قال هذا حديث حسن غريب»; neither is a route
